versions.localizedDescription:
Roam Control 0.9.3, Build 63.

### Highlights

- Manual route drawing where Apple walking directions are unavailable.
- Route planning from an active simulated location, including intermediate waypoints with a fixed destination.
- Manual Diagnostics in Connection Health with short support codes for troubleshooting.
- Automatic and manual release update checking.
- Improved pairing-expiry guidance and notifications.
- Improved timezone handling and restoration during location simulation.
- Improved Stop & Restore, background-session and recovery messaging.
- Improved map recentering and route-planning controls.
- Improved Connection Health and troubleshooting information.

**Known issue:** A region-specific location-selection accuracy issue remains under investigation in some configurations.

See the [full changelog](../../blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for the complete list of changes.

### Requirements

- iOS 27 or newer
- Developer Mode
- LocalDevVPN
- SideStore or another compatible personal-signing workflow

Install this build over the existing copy to retain local app data.
